raw_response:
Updated the existing Treasury Bulletin federal department/agency expenditures skill and memory.

Generalizable lessons saved:
- Average YoY growth over an inclusive FY range should be the arithmetic mean of adjacent annual percentage changes, not CAGR.
- For OLS of ln(outlays) on “fiscal year index,” use a 1-based sequential index (1..n) unless explicitly specified otherwise; using 0..n-1 shifts the intercept by one slope.
- When metric-specific rounding conflicts with generic “all numbers” rounding, preserve the metric-specific rule where benchmark style indicates it, e.g. YoY percent to hundredths while regression values to thousandths.
